type.description: Every task type a task can have and a station can claim: the creatable TaskType values plus `RELOCATE` (a slot-plan move, ADR-0047), `REPLENISH` (a pick-face replenishment, ADR-0050) and `BREAK_CASE` (open a sealed case into loose eaches, ADR-0054, claimable since ADR-0055). RELOCATE, REPLENISH and BREAK_CASE tasks are created only from WorkReleased on their process paths, never through `POST /tasks`, because they need the planned move or break. A claimed BREAK_CASE task completes only through `POST /tasks/{id}/break-case`.
type.title: AnyTaskType

fragile.description: Packing hint carried from task creation — see CreateTaskRequest.fragile. Does not affect claiming.

giftWrap.description: Read-only packing hint: true if this task's order was flagged for gift wrap at work-enqueue time. Unlike fragile, it has no HTTP ingestion path — it arrives only via WorkReleased.data.gift_wrap (see ADR-0011) and cannot be set through POST /tasks. Does not affect claiming or capability matching.

leaseStationId.description: The station currently holding the active claim, if any.

leaseExpiry.description: When the active claim's lease expires, if any.

relocation.description: The slot-plan move a RELOCATE task executes (ADR-0047), from WorkReleased.data.relocation. An open side is omitted: `fromBin` of an Assign and `toBin` of a Vacate are scanned by the operator at completion.

moveSeq.description: The move's 0-based position in the plan.

fromBin.description: Planned source bin; omitted for an Assign.

toBin.description: Planned destination bin; omitted for a Vacate.

ref.description: The move reference `<planId>:<moveSeq>`, published as TaskCompleted.relocation_ref.

executed.description: The executed move, present once the task is completed.

relocation.title: TaskRelocation

replenishment.description: The pick-face replenishment move a REPLENISH task executes (ADR-0050), from WorkReleased.data.replenishment. Both bins are always known. `priority` is recorded for the operator's view; claimNext orders by CPT only.

requestId.description: The replenishment request id, published as TaskCompleted.request_ref.

executed.description: The executed move, present once the task is completed.

replenishment.title: TaskReplenishment
